The '''Rozzum''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Rozzum|same name]]. In ancient [[Time/Legends|times]], many [[Jedi Shadow]]s knew how to speak Rozzum as fluently as [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] or [[Sith (language)|Sith]].
